change: Require contact name, email and phone for consented workshop scans, render them into the personal PDF, and persist phone only in the private portal intake and canonical portal state.
prevention_rule: Every consented workshop scan must keep one submission_key, require company name, contact name, email and phone, render contact name/email/phone into both PDF pages, store PII only in the service-role-only workshop_portal_intakes and authenticated portal projection, and keep aggregate benchmark/growth learning PII-free.
root_cause: The workshop scan already collected name and email but did not expose the participant identity in the generated PDF, and there was no phone field in the canonical private intake. That made the report less personal and left the follow-up contact record incomplete.
